conclusion: A grid-discretised Cohn-Elkies LP does not bound f(0)/fhat(0): the free LP is unbounded below (unbounded ray with f(0) -> -inf). With the rigorous floor f(0) >= 3/(32 pi) forced, the optimum is the floor itself, i.e. the grid conditions are vacuous. Exact SOS/Gram identities are therefore mandatory; do not submit grid baselines.
